subject: English
passage: If ancient microorganisms such as bacteria and archaea ______ the ocean floor from deep-sea volcanic vents and established colonies—a possibility marine biologist Dr. Latoya Collier outlined in a 2019 study—the microorganisms could have evolved into more complex forms that eventually led to the diverse ecosystems we observe in the deep ocean today.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of verbs to express tense. In this choice, the past perfect verb "had colonized" is used correctly to describe a past action that was completed before another action in the past. Specifically, in this hypothetical scenario about deep-sea evolution, the microorganisms had to have colonized the ocean floor before they could evolve into more complex forms.
